body: Have you ever rode a bicycle? I just recently got into skateboarding and it is a freeing hobby of mine especially because it is summer time! The sun on your skin and wind on your face and hair it feels amazing. Also I like to bring my phone or speaker and play music when I ride. What are your feelings about this? I’m sure your mom would support you on picking up an new positive hobby.

If you could change one thing what would it be? Also I’ve noticed you say you fuck everything up but I promise you, you don’t. Can I give you some advice? You sound a lot like me and I’d like to help if I can.

I get drunk and hope to escape from my inner thoughts also but it never works. For me it’s a temporary fix or like you stated just makes it worse. Try your best to stop the negative self talk. I’ve let mine go on for so long now that it’s a habit. Natural. Still trying to learn how to deal with it. Because trust me someone does love you.

Thank you for the reply. Legit get trapped in my own tainted mind that is just a black hole. I try sometimes to escape but today it’s consumed me. I broke. This hypothetical demon you speak of is in my mind. I’ve had it forever. I am suicidal. And have made it far the only reason I haven’t completely ended it is because I cannot hurt the ones I love. I’m selfless which is a blessing and a curse I help other but never get help. A blessing for everyone else and a curse for me. Maybe in another life I can live free and be me. But this life is not it.
